audit.baseline_worktree: Clean when first inspected; this inventory describes the starting revision, not concurrent agent changes.
audit.method: Read the 333-row catalog, recovered row jump table, preference literals, selected native symbols/assembly/Objective-C methods, installation patches, clean-room implementations, and assembled downstream consumers. Search exact keys and known public-fork aliases. A catalog descriptor, generated state property, throwing SDK wrapper, or unrelated stock Telegram feature is not an implementation.
audit.validation_level: Static source connectivity and recovered-evidence audit. No application build, device run, network request, or test suite was run for this audit.
audit.revision_note: Port evidence line numbers refer to Git revision 6d8f529232b4633045f10fb04bc1ad7f18fe50ac even where other agents subsequently modified that path. Assembled/public trees were inspected read-only.

definitions.implemented_and_connected: A reachable control/action and installed downstream consumer implement the row's identifiable function. This is source-level coverage, not proof of original defaults, visuals, binary equivalence, or device correctness.
definitions.partial: Some relevant behavior exists, but scope, original semantics, persistence compatibility, or catalog-to-runtime binding is incomplete. Headers are partial presentation scaffolding and are counted separately.
definitions.absent: No connected implementation of the original row was found. Metadata/state-only rows and explicit unavailable controls remain absent, even if an unrelated replacement exists.
definitions.original_evidence: Every case number resolves to O_CASES at line case+11 and O_MAP at line case+14; the port catalog line is case+29. keys lists only literals actually present in O_KEYS, not guessed wg_ prefixes. Empty keys does not mean the original lacked a preference: the recovered state/callback evidence remains in O_MAP. extra references strengthen particular claims.
definitions.source_runtime_evidence: References resolve to the evidence dictionary. Paths use roots above; suffixes after the final colon are line ranges in the audited snapshot. R_NONE records bounded negative evidence, not a proof about unexamined compiler-erased original code.
definitions.sections: Numeric sections are preserved from the generated port catalog. Friendly names are audit group labels; section 16 contains many unrelated later additions. They do not establish original conditional screen layout.

priorities.P2: Larger feature or recover an unresolved original contract first
priorities.P3: Parity validation, wording, or presentation finishing

definitions.structural_rows: headerRow and textRow entries are retained to account for all 333 rows. Their counts must not be presented as independent working features. Dynamic status text is assessed on its actual data producer.
definitions.original_parity: All catalog labelsVerified values are false. Generated defaults are not recovered defaults. Narrow source coverage does not certify exact 3.1.1 parity. In particular, native getter evidence overrides suspect generated state types.

summary.inventory_integrity: 333 unique keys match baseline catalog order, section and kind; each original menu-case reference and recovered literal was checked. Counts are row coverage, not 333 independent features.

uncertainties_and_limits: No Swift build/device parity was established by this audit; reported installed consumers are source evidence only. Existing PORT_STATUS test counts are not reused as runtime proof.

Row identities and control classes are recovered, but exact copy/defaults/ranges/conditional display are not verified for all rows. R_NONE is bounded negative evidence from baseline source and known aliases.
The absence of a literal from O_KEYS is not proof the original lacks a setting. Some names are recovered state/callbacks only; no wg_ storage name is invented for them.

Original scope for hideSearchBar, hidePhoneNumber, hideReactions and compact-panel equivalence remains unresolved. Their concrete current narrower behavior is recorded rather than asserted as original parity.
Local voice DSP is a functional new implementation. Original preset coefficients, timbre/clarity bounds and acoustic equivalence are unresolved; original selective bleeping is absent.
Original generated state types can be misleading: localStarsCount is demonstrably Int64 in SGSettings despite a generated Bool. Other suspect fields require native getter evidence before use.
Profile/backend URL fragments and reconstructed sources do not establish request/authentication semantics or deployed service availability. No network service was contacted.

Concurrent history/plugin/appearance changes observed after the initial clean read are intentionally excluded. Re-audit their final committed revision and freshly assembled target before updating these counts.

outside_catalog_observations.subject: Other original screens
outside_catalog_observations.finding: 333 rows are not an exhaustive original implementation count. Menu-map lists 76 additional screen/type structures including radio, chat lock, API-status, localization and plugin-language surfaces; many native APIs also have no dedicated catalog row. This audit does not promote them through section/header counts.

O_CASES.finding: 333 WhitegramEntry cases, 282 code blocks; builder 0xddbe18..0xde4f5c, jump table 0xde4f5c. Establishes row identity/control class, not every behavioral detail.

O_MAP.finding: Original entry/state/callback candidates. Name-based key associations are explicitly candidates, not recovered implementation bodies.

O_KEYS.finding: Exact recovered literals without inferred defaults. Each row's keys array is checked against this list.

O_METHODS.finding: WhitegramEntry protocol witnesses and evidence limitations; native candidates are not a complete stock diff.

O_STICKER.finding: SGSettings.stickerSizeScale getter compares the loaded value to zero and selects 1.0 for zero. The port instead supports zero as hidden stickers and clamps to 0..1; full original range remains unresolved.

O_CAMERA.finding: WGCameraSettingsController has stockChanged, backPresetChanged, backFPSChanged, frontPresetChanged, frontFPSChanged, wideAngleChanged and bitrateChanged. Camera direction alone does not cover this screen.

O_ACCOUNTS.finding: Transfer imports session files and tdata and exports accounts; PortableAccount carries dcId/authKey/userId/name/phone, with readTelethonSession/writeTelethonSession/makeSessionBackup. Original Keychain backup and bot-login types also exist.

O_FROZEN.finding: WGFrozenAccountsStore exposes markFrozen, clear, entry, isFrozen and allFrozenAccountIds; frozen account records include accountId, peerId, reason and frozenAt.

O_STARS.finding: SGSettings.localStarsCount is Int64; its getter is 0x201828. The port's generated localStarsCount: Bool is a concrete type mismatch.

O_VT.finding: WGVirusTotalManager includes extractTarget/extractAllTargets, testConnection, scanIP, scanUrl and scanFile with progress. Hash-only report lookup is a subset.

O_AI.finding: WGGeminiChatViewController has message-table, sendTapped, cancelReply and clearHistoryTapped methods; Gemini/Groq chat-history-v5 keys exist. Single-turn in-memory generation is not the complete original chat.

O_VOICE.finding: Original local mode gate and pitch/echo bounds are recoverable. Remote manager has changeVoice/fetchVoices/changeVideoAudio. Bleep processor has transcribeAndBleep and process(oggPath:appLocale:completion:); whole-recording tone replacement is different behavior.

O_PLAYER.finding: Equalizer controller has reset/preset controls; musicEqualizerBands is [Float]. Music speed, pitch-following, crossfade enabled/duration and equalizer enabled are distinct recovered settings.

O_SCAM.finding: WGScammerDatabaseManager includes publicKeyBytes, snapshotURLBytes, refreshIfNeeded and isScammer(peerId:). A guessed static blocklist would not reproduce its signed-snapshot behavior.

O_PROFILES.finding: Separate lyric/quote/photo-wall/photos/reactions/scene/wall editors, managers, payload keys and change notifications exist. A generic stock profile editor does not cover them.

O_ONLINE.finding: WGOnlineHistoryViewController contains SGOnlineHistoryEntry arrays, peer filtering, date sections and pagination; this is distinct from message history.

O_ANALYTICS.finding: WGApiUsageStats records paths and returns counts/total for a number of days; analyticsEvents_v2 is recovered. Menu metadata alone does not determine every analyticsStaticRow value.

R_INSTALL.finding: Assembler installs the actual implementations and startup bridge. Core owns preferences/history/voice, TelegramUIPreferences owns the fork bridge, SettingsUI owns controllers/services/plugins, Display owns font registry.

R_NONE.finding: No allowed row handler/consumer for the audited key or recovered alias. Exact-key/known-alias searches in assembled submodules found catalog/state scaffolding unless another evidence record below says otherwise. Unmapped rows render implementation not connected; writable state fields by themselves are not behavior.

R_HEADER.finding: All-settings renders header rows, but their titles are camel-case-derived placeholders and all original labels remain unverified. availableOnly hides unsupported headers. Presentation scaffolding only.

R_INFO.finding: This original explanatory/preview row falls through to the generic implementation-not-connected text; nearby new help text does not restore its original copy or dynamic content.

R_HISTORY.finding: Capture before deletion/edit and after incoming cloud storage is installed. Account-local text/metadata archive is capped at 2000 entries/8 MiB/~8 KiB text. No inline deleted-message retention, media payload archive, original edit-history UI, or restored Telegram chat exists at baseline.

R_HISTORY_IO.finding: JSON import/export and event-filtered clearing work on the new local archive. Every recovered history action routes to the same unfiltered manager; individual clear/export/import/restore intent is not dispatched. Original backup-format compatibility is not established.

R_AVATAR.finding: Three AvatarNode rendering entry points change round clipping to roundedRect when squareAvatars is set. Existing node refresh and exact original corner radius need device comparison.

R_COMPACT.finding: Catalog routes to the public chat settings control; shared compactChatList key drives actual shorter/single-line chat-list layout. Public restart/apply behavior is preserved.

R_STICKER.finding: Reachable public slider renders static/animated stickers using 0..100 percent; zero hides ordinary stickers and premium-like stickers are exempt. Original zero/default behavior differs (O_STICKER).

R_CAMERA.finding: Front/back/ask selection reaches requestVideoRecorder(initialFrontCamera:) and the real camera screen. Routing cameraSettingsButton to general chat settings does not supply original FPS/preset/bitrate/wide-angle controls.

R_SETTINGS_MENU.finding: Shared hide keys invert into public settings-menu options; actual Saved Messages/Calls/Devices/Folders/Premium/Stars/Business/Gifts/Help/FAQ/Tips item builders check the options.

R_SETTINGS_DIRECT.finding: Before sections are emitted, row IDs are filtered by hide keys: edit 0/1/2, accounts 100, profile 0, proxy 0, advanced 0/1/2/3/4/6.

R_WALLET.finding: Public overlay unconditionally skips bot shortName wallet and removes the stock My TON item (confirmed against target HEAD diff). hideWallet is not read and cannot restore visibility. This is hardcoded suppression, not the recovered switch.

R_TIMESTAMP.finding: Shared showTimestampSeconds maps to the public timestamp formatter, including edit/imported-date text.

R_VIEW_COUNT.finding: ChatMessageDateAndStatusNode uses String(impressionCount) instead of abbreviated count when showFullViewCount is set.

R_PHONE.finding: hidePhoneNumber only guards the phone disclosure row in settingsEditingItems. No general profile/header/other phone rendering guard was installed.

R_TABS.finding: Contacts/calls visibility and tab labels reach actual root/tab component construction. Compact panel keeps those controllers for its alternate menu. hideSearchBar maps only to hideSearchButton; hideBottomTabBar maps to compactPanel.

R_STORIES.finding: Story settings are bridged and observed; recording-swipe gestures check disableStoryRecordingSwipe. hideStories produces empty effectiveStorySubscriptions in actual header construction.

R_GALLERY.finding: hideGalleryCamera maps to hideCameraInGallery and removes the gallery camera cell/camera availability.

R_TRANSLATION.finding: translateMessagesEnabled drives the public automatic received-message translation path. Google/Telegram and per-message/per-chat language selection exist. Automatic translation uses UI base language; no recovered global translationTargetLang, localTranslationEnabled, or before-send/voice-translation gate is connected. The branch called enableLocalIfPossible installs the Google service, not proof of offline Apple translation.

R_CHAT_SWIPE.finding: disableChatSwipeOptions is inverted into chatSwipeOptions and consumed by actual chat-list swipe-action construction.

R_MIC.finding: Recording/camera call sites invoke a helper that checks forceDeviceMicrophone and calls AVAudioSession.setPreferredInput for builtInMic. Errors are swallowed by inherited try?; on-device routing/error behavior and call-specific scope remain unverified.

R_ADS.finding: AdMessages initialization/activation return empty sponsored-message state for disableAds or hideChannelAds. AdPeers search returns empty for disableAds. Existing visible/in-flight ad state still needs live-toggle validation.

R_DOUBLE_TAP.finding: doubleTapEditEnabled selects the public personal-chat edit action; actual bubble/static/animated-sticker double taps invoke ChatController's setupEditMessage handler.

R_WIDE.finding: wideChannelPosts reaches the public channel width helper and actual bubble/media layout consumers.

R_REACTIONS.finding: hideReactions only inverts broadcast-channel channelPostReactions; personal/group reactions are not controlled. Original scope needs confirmation before treating this alias as parity.

R_GHOST_ONLINE.finding: Presence computes !suppressOnlineStatus && (requested || alwaysOnline), with preference observer/timer rescheduling. Ghost overrides alwaysOnline. It operates while this client executes, not through forced termination.

R_GHOST_ACTIVITY.finding: Typing/sticker/game/emoji activity, voice/video recording and media upload activity are separately gated. Group-call speaking activity is deliberately outside these gates.

R_GHOST_READ.finding: Cloud/content/discussion/Saved Messages/bulk mention-reaction-poll reads and encrypted read service actions are gated. Local completion and secret sequence slots are retained; this is not packet-capture verification.

R_GHOST_STORY.finding: Both story view increments and queued seen-story synchronization consult the ghost/story-read gate.

R_FONTS.finding: Reachable system picker/import/library/select/reset/remove operations persist settings and register CoreText fonts. Eight general Font helpers consume the registry. Library uses port fontHistory/name/source/fileName schema, not a verified importer for original wg_customFontHistory/path records. Direct UIFont and extension fonts remain outside these hooks.

R_ACCOUNTS.finding: The Accounts screen lists account-record IDs, switches current ID, and starts ordinary Telegram auth. It contains no original Keychain backup/restore, session/tdata transfer, bot-token login, frozen-account retention or switcher-enable implementation.

R_VOICE_BUTTON.finding: hideRecordButton inverts voiceMessageButton; recording action, button layout and availability consume it.

R_CHANNEL_SWIPE.finding: noChannelSwitch disables the next-unread-channel offer, overscroll gesture and navigation action.

R_FOLDERS.finding: Public Folders at Bottom control and layout work, but WhiteGramChatFolderSettings.v1 is not bridged into WhitegramPreferences and the recovered catalog row is inert. This is an immediate missing binding, not missing rendering code.

R_PLUGINS.finding: Explicit Run/Stop account-scoped JavaScript manager, file/JSON packages, storage, HTTP, native UI and selected Telegram operations are connected. Baseline lacks original global message/request hooks, injection, alternate languages, original package compatibility and durable jobs. Per-peer local message watches are not global incoming events.

R_ICONS.finding: A real bundled app-icon picker calls setAlternateIconName and verifies system state. It does not implement original downloadable/custom settings icon packs, pack creation or the pack-site preview.

R_VT.finding: Enabled manual SHA-256/file-hash lookup performs GET /api/v3/files/{hash}; actual report/not-found/error parsing exists. No original URL/IP scan, upload/submission/progress pipeline, or message-context attachment action is connected.

R_SERVICE_KEYS.finding: Masked editors save provider credentials in Keychain; production request wrappers read them with legacy migration. Service credentials are distinct from Telegram account/session backup.

R_VT_STATUS.finding: Status changes from real hash lookup outcomes and resets on key change. Original dedicated testConnection plus URL/IP/file-scanning status is not reproduced.

R_VOICE.finding: New local DSP processes 48-kHz mono Int16 before waveform/Opus, so recording preview and send share the output. Preset names/IDs exist, but coefficients and some control ranges are reimplementations. Remote mode and call audio are unavailable; video-message audio is unhooked.

R_BLEEP.finding: The port adds voiceBleepWholeRecording as an opt-in for replacing all samples with beep/silence. It does not transcribe, match profanity, or selectively bleep words. This alternative receives no credit for original automatic censoring.

R_AI.finding: Shared master enable, provider selector, separate model/key editors and actual Gemini/Groq single-user-message requests are connected. No persisted original chat session, multi-turn conversation, selection-to-AI call site, or recovered app-proxy flags are connected.

R_SETTINGS_IO.finding: Shared JSON/UserDefaults persistence and credential migration exist. There is no recovered settings document export/import or settings Keychain save/restore action. History JSON and service-key storage are different features.
